pages.title: Polarity of Defense
pages.text: Changing shield polarity offers different ways to control an enemy.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain Heart of Iron from Magnetron; nearby anvils and sawmills strengthen its assembled limbs. Sneak-use the shield to switch: Azure repels, Scarlet attracts.

pages.title: Practical note

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Mine a suitable block with the Gauntlet and project a recorded creature. Hold Gauntlet offhand and a magnetic tool mainhand. Record a creature with Holocoder and insert the record into a projector; Telecores maintain the tool.
